enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Stretch arms. Roll onto back. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a hot morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Turn off alarm. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water in the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Boil water. Take out bread. Insert bread into toaster. Toast bread. Take out butter and jam. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Spread butter and jam on toast. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Finish eating. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag and laptop for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Put on shoes. Pick up backpack. Open backpack. Put laptop in backpack. Put charger in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone and keys. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Take elevator. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Check calendar. Pick up phone. Call partner. Discuss details. Take notes. Open program files. Review documents. Edit document. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up printout. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Wait for food. Pick up food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Pick up tray. Return tray. Walk out. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: preparing program materials and planning upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open planning document. Review checklist. Call venue. Send emails. Update spreadsheet. Print materials. Assemble packets. Staple papers. Organize folders. Label folders. Write notes. File documents. Check inventory. Order supplies. Update calendar.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter apartment.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Serve food. Eat dinner. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and unwinding after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll phone. Put phone down. Adjust pillow. Lie back. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Get water. Sit down. Turn on TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening hot shower (delayed until after the 5pm-8pm water-heater peak tax window)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off tap. Step out. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and scrolling the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like posts. Put phone down. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply. Put phone down. Adjust pillow. Lie back. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly under the desk lamp and reviewing tomorrow's program to-do list
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Pick up notebook. Open notebook. Review to-do list. Write notes. Close notebook. Set alarm. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Stretch arms. Sleep.
